translations.web: When the child was grown, one day he went out to his father to the reapers.
translations.bsb: And the child grew, and one day he went out to his father, who was with the harvesters.
translations.kjv: And when the child was grown, it fell on a day, that he went out to his father to the reapers.
translations.asv: And when the child was grown, it fell on a day, that he went out to his father to the reapers.
